scope: Manual actual installed-wiring STEP/manifest binding to the current source electrical graph and native wiring bodies, including their placements inside the complete appliance STEP. No equipment/contact sweep or mechanical regeneration. Unchanged accepted contact receipts remain separately scoped.

native_source_cache.scope: Reuse unchanged native source solids only after matching current source curves, termination records and jacket geometry. All actual STEP wiring bodies are read back in this command.

exchange_scope: Native source solids and geometric agreement are distinct from STEP reader orientation validity. Any listed readback-invalid bodies retain their explicit exchange limitation; no per-wire geometry is altered to silence it.
